changelog:
tokenized-agents v0.1.0

- Initial release providing integration guidance for Solana-based agent payments using @pump-fun/agent-payments-sdk.
- Includes strict usage checklist (mint, payment currency, price, RPC, framework) to require user input before proceeding.
- Documents required safety rules, supported currencies, runtime environment variables, and installation/versioning guidance for dependencies.
- Adds setup instructions for the PumpAgent SDK and wallet adapter integration.
- Details methods for building and verifying payment transactions, along with parameter requirements and type safety checks.
summary: Use when the user wants to charge users for actions. Use @pump-fun/agent-payments-sdk, to build Solana payment transactions, verify on-chain invoice payments...
